options.label: A
options.text: Overlays never lift, frequency fences are eternal, and museum basements will remain the only place truth is allowed forever.
options.rationale: Overlay removal is imminent preparation territory; Oopa literacy is for recognition of restoration, not permanent basement exile.

options.label: B
options.text: Oopas are irrelevant once coal plants expand, because fossil fuel already equals native self-powering simulation physics in every respect.
options.rationale: Fossil dependence is the prison; the realm is natively self-powering beneath scarcity programming.

options.label: C
options.text: Oopas dismantle Perceived Knowledge; suppressing Tuning Forks and condensers locked scarcity, finance, and fossil dependence.
options.rationale: Oopa truth breaks Perceived Knowledge and prepares you for overlay removal; clinging to fake evolution collapses under the reveal.

options.label: D
options.text: Strategic value is only financial: auctioning giant femurs privately while keeping the population asleep on linear history.
options.rationale: The point is sovereignty and recognition at reveal, not auctioning vaulted bones while sleep continues.

questions.hint: Break Perceived Knowledge — prepare for overlay removal and restoration.
